title: @DonaldClark bad bits of behaviourism bring in billions in ad bids biting on bad behavior bought in fits of gigabits that sip at brain's basic nature
summary: @DonaldClark bad bits of behaviourism bring in billions in ad bids biting on bad behavior bought in fits of gigabits that sip at brain's basic nature #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@DonaldClark
bad bits of behaviourism
bring in billions
in ad bids
biting
on
bad
behavior
bought
in fits
of gigabits
that sip
at brain's
basic
nature
#smallpoems
